## How to Make Sidebar Sticky?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-make-sidebar-sticky/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

To enable sticky sidebar, all you need to do is follow the step listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Content > Sidebar**.
- Locate **Sticky Content and Sidebar.**
- Put a checkmark on **Check to activate the sticky options for content and sidebar areas.**
- Click on **Publish**.
